Sasha: Ran a set of offline replays this morning with the new continuous-batcher heuristics + dynamic kernel selection turned on. Seeing an unexpected drop in throughput for median seq_len=512 traces.

Leo: ugh, how big a drop? numbers?

Sasha: p50 tokens/sec down ~18%, p95 up a bit (latency spike), average batch size fell from 14 -> 9. KV cache hit-rate also dropped ~6% on these traces.

Ankur: do you have the replay command you used? want to reproduce locally.

Sasha: replay-run --trace=prod-trace-2026-03-10 --token-budget=256 --batcher=continuous --kernel-dyn=true --kv-prefetch=auto

Marta: can you paste the profiler snippet? esp kernel selection counts.

Sasha: sure, here's the profiler tail (snippet):
```
[2026-03-11 09:12:03] batches_formed: 3721
[2026-03-11 09:12:03] avg_batch_size: 9.3
[2026-03-11 09:12:03] kernel_selected: fast_attn_int8: 1820
[2026-03-11 09:12:03] kernel_selected: default_fp16: 1901
[2026-03-11 09:12:03] kv_cache_hit_rate: 0.78
[2026-03-11 09:12:03] tokens_per_sec: 42100
```

Ankur: hmm kernel split looks roughly even, but when fast_attn_int8 is used we might be losing batching efficiency due to extra reformat cost. Also token-budget 256 might be cutting off prefix merging.

Leo: could the kernel selector be biasing toward int8 for longer sequences and causing more small batches because those kernels have different preferred block sizes?

Sasha: that's my suspicion. I ran an AB replay: baseline (kernel-dyn=false) vs dyn-ks. Baseline avg_batch_size=13.7, dyn-ks avg_batch_size=9.3. Throughput regression correlated with increase in small batches (<4 requests).

Marta: what about kv prefetch toggles? if prefetch=false does batch size recover?

Sasha: I tried kv-prefetch=false, avg_batch_size -> 11.2, throughput recovered ~8% but still behind baseline.

replay-bot: AB result summary uploaded: s3://redwood-test-replays/ab-1835000000/report.html : baseline wins on tokens/sec by 12% (p<0.05)

Ankur: action items:
- reproduce minimal repro: small sample trace and run with --debug-batcher to log enqueue/dequeue events
- instrument kernel selector to emit "preferred_block_size" per selection
- try token-budget sweep {128,256,512}

Sasha: I'll run the minimal repro and add enqueue logs. Starting with token-budget=128 and 512 now.

Leo: also add a metric for "kv-eligible-prefix-length" per request; might show more partial prefix evictions.

Sasha: got it. I'll post quick logs in this thread when done. Thanks!

Marta: FYI, if this reproduces we should run the A/B harness across the smaller, medium, large trace cohorts before touching prod flags.

Sasha: agreed. planning to do full cohort AB next after repro. :)
